tools.name: payram_get_mcp_config
tools.description: Return the MCP server configuration JSON to register the PayRam MCP server in any MCP-capable agent (Claude, Copilot, OpenClaw, n8n, LangChain, Cursor, Windsurf). No API key is required to connect.

tools.name: payram_get_setup_command
tools.description: Return the one-line bash command to deploy a self-hosted PayRam node on an Ubuntu 22.04+ VPS. Modes: "agent" (headless CLI) or "human" (web dashboard).

tools.name: payram_list_supported_chains
tools.description: Return blockchains and stablecoins PayRam supports, with typical on-chain fees (USD) and finality time (seconds).

tools.name: payram_search_blog
tools.description: Search the PayRam blog by keyword. Returns matching posts with slug, title, description, category. Max 10 results.
